# `feature_translate` Gap Analysis

## Executive Summary

The package implements a **complete MVP** for both translation modes: hold-to-record → stream PCM over HTTP POST → parse SSE (`dataType` 1/2/3) → update UI → optionally push translation to glasses via BLE `0x46`. Architecture is clean and shared between modes via one `TranslateController` with mode-specific Riverpod providers.

**What’s solid:** SSE parsing (camelCase + snake_case), language direction flip for face-to-face, streaming ASR/translation display, TTS playback, language picker, routing, zh/en l10n strings defined, one focused unit test file.

**Main gaps:** Face-to-face has **no error UI**; many l10n keys are **unused**; TTS toggle lacks the headphone warning dialog (unlike interpretation); BLE integration is **minimal** (no status frames, no streaming partials, no disconnect handling); no history persistence; thin test coverage; several **ponytail** shortcuts documented but not addressed.

---

## Architecture & Data Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as Page (OneKey / FaceToFace)
    participant Ctrl as TranslateController
    participant Audio as InterpretationAudioEngine
    participant Upload as TranslateUploadService
    participant GW as Wake AI Gateway
    participant BLE as GlassesCommandSender

    UI->>Ctrl: startRecording(speaker?)
    Ctrl->>Ctrl: request mic permission
    Ctrl->>Audio: start() + micPcmStream
    Ctrl->>Upload: streamTranslate(audioChunks, fromId, toId)
    Upload->>GW: POST machine/v2/function/speechRecognition
    GW-->>Upload: SSE lines (ASR / translation / TTS)
    Upload-->>Ctrl: TranslateSseEvent stream
    Ctrl->>UI: update currentAsrText / currentTransText
    Ctrl->>BLE: sendSimInterText (if connected)
    Ctrl->>Audio: pushTtsPcm (if TTS enabled)
    UI->>Ctrl: stopRecording()
    Ctrl->>Upload: close audioBridge → end POST body
    Ctrl->>Ctrl: commit entry → idle
```

---

## Assets & `pubspec.yaml`

| Item | State |
|------|-------|
| `pubspec.yaml` | 9 deps: `core_audio`, `core_ble`, `core_network`, `core_permission`, `common_glasses_protocol`, `common_ui`, `core_theme`, Riverpod, go_router |
| Assets declared | `assets/images/entry/` |
| Assets on disk | `assets/images/entry/icon_translate@2x.png` (exists), `assets/l10n/app_zh.arb`, `app_en.arb` |
| `l10n.yaml` | Generates `TranslateL10n` → `lib/src/l10n/generated/` |
| Dead config fields | `TranslateConfig.authorization`, `apiKey`, `enableTts` — **defined but never read** inside the package |

---

## File-by-File Summary

### `lib/feature_translate.dart` (barrel)
- **Does:** Public exports for config, controller, models, pages, routing, language service.
- **Works:** Clean API surface for app integration.
- **Gaps:** Does not export widgets (internal by design).

---

### Controller & State

#### `lib/src/controller/translate_controller.dart`
- **Does:** Core session lifecycle for both modes. Bridges mic PCM → chunked upload → SSE listener → state updates + BLE push + TTS.
- **Works:**
  - Mic permission via `core_permission`
  - 1280-byte chunking (40ms @ 16kHz, same as simultaneous interpretation)
  - `resolveTranslateDirection()` — speaker 0 uses configured direction; speaker 1 reverses it
  - One-key keeps only latest entry; face-to-face appends history
  - TTS drained before returning to idle
  - BLE push is optional (skips when disconnected)
- **Gaps / ponytail:**
  - `mutualFlag` hardcoded `false` — each speaker gets a separate unidirectional request
  - `BytesBuilder` unbounded buffer under slow network
  - Engine kept alive until SSE done (no `stopCapturing()` split)
  - Mic stream `onError` propagates to bridge but **no user-facing handling**
  - `toggleTts()` does not call `resetTtsOutput()` when muting (interpretation does)
  - BLE push on **every** translation SSE event, no `isFinal` gate (interpretation sends final only)
  - BLE errors only `debugPrint`, no user feedback
  - No BLE disconnect listener to stop/cleanup mid-session
  - Permission/mic errors use raw `error.message` / `e.toString()`, not l10n helpers
  - `TranslateEntry.ttsPlayed` never updated

#### `lib/src/model/translate_state.dart`
- **Does:** `TranslateStatus` (idle/recording/processing/error), entries, streaming text, speaker, TTS flag, error string.
- **Works:** `isLive` correctly covers recording + processing.
- **Gaps:** No typed error enum (unlike interpretation’s `InterpretationErrorKind`); no disconnect-dialog flag; no TTS-playing status exposed to UI.

#### `lib/src/model/translate_entry.dart`
- **Does:** One conversation turn: speaker, original, translated, `ttsPlayed`.
- **Gaps:** `ttsPlayed` is dead field.

#### `lib/src/model/selected_translate_languages_provider.dart`
- **Does:** AutoDispose notifier for `(fromId, toId)`; initializes from config; `swap()`.
- **Works:** Resets when page closes.

---

### SSE & Services

#### `lib/src/model/translate_sse_response.dart`
- **Does:** Parses `data:` SSE lines; supports `dataType` 1/2/3; camelCase + snake_case + nested `data` wrapper; TTS as int array or base64.
- **Works:** Well-tested; ignores `[DONE]`, empty lines, unknown types.
- **Gaps:** Unknown/malformed JSON silently becomes `unknown` type (filtered out upstream); no server error payload parsing.

#### `lib/src/service/translate_upload_service.dart`
- **Does:** `POST machine/v2/function/speechRecognition` with query params (`fromLanguageId`, `toLanguageId`, `transFlag=true`, `ttsFlag`, `mutualTranslationFlag`); body = PCM stream; returns filtered SSE event stream.
- **Works:** Uses `core_network.streamPost`; no retry policy.
- **Gaps:** No request timeout; no HTTP status error mapping; path/params hardcoded.

#### `lib/src/service/translate_language_service.dart`
- **Does:** Fetches `machine/v2/aiChargeClient/languageList`; `translateLanguagesProvider` falls back to config defaults on failure.
- **Works:** Silent degradation to 2 default languages.
- **Gaps:** `referenceLanguageId` hardcoded `175`; no loading/error UI in language bar; failure only logged.

#### `lib/src/config/translate_config.dart`
- **Does:** App-injected config: base URL, language defaults (175=中文, 83=英语), headers.
- **Gaps:** `authorization`, `apiKey`, `enableTts` unused inside package.

---

### Pages & Widgets

#### `lib/src/pages/one_key_translate_page.dart`
- **Does:** Single mic, result area (ASR + translation box), TTS toggle, language bar.
- **Works:** Hold-to-record flow; shows streaming text while live; shows last entry when idle; **displays network errors** via `l10n.networkError`.
- **Gaps:** No processing spinner in result area (only on mic button); no retry button; error label says "network error" even for mic/permission failures.

#### `lib/src/pages/face_to_face_translate_page.dart`
- **Does:** Chat bubble list, dual mic bar (甲方 right / 乙方 left), clear history, TTS toggle, auto-scroll.
- **Works:** Speaker-based bubble alignment; in-progress bubble with partial ASR/translation; processing indicator when ASR empty; blocks second mic while `isLive`.
- **Gaps:**
  - **No error display at all** — errors invisible to user
  - No TTS headphone warning on toggle
  - `tapForSpeakerA`, `recognizingStatus`, `ttsPlayingStatus` l10n keys unused
  - Empty hint same as one-key ("按住麦克风按钮") — not tailored to dual-mic UX

#### `lib/src/pages/widgets/translate_mic_button.dart`
- **Does:** Long-press start/stop; visual states for recording (filled) and processing (spinner).
- **Gaps:** Hardcoded `'●  '` prefix when recording (not l10n); no disabled/error visual state.

#### `lib/src/pages/widgets/translate_chat_bubble.dart`
- **Does:** Completed bubble with original + italic translation; avatar for speaker B, accent avatar for speaker A.
- **Works:** Visual differentiation clear.

#### `lib/src/pages/widgets/translate_language_bar.dart`
- **Does:** From/to chips + swap button + bottom-sheet picker.
- **Works:** Disabled during live session; fallback names from config when API fails.
- **Gaps:** No sheet title l10n; no loading indicator while `translateLanguagesProvider` loads; picker uses `displayName()` always (no locale-aware `preferEn`).

#### `lib/src/pages/translate_entry_item.dart`
- **Does:** Home tile → bottom sheet → route to one-key or face-to-face.
- **Works:** Uses package asset icon with `package: 'feature_translate'`.

---

### Routing

#### `lib/src/routing/translate_route_paths.dart` + `translate_routes.dart`
- **Does:** `/translate/one-key`, `/translate/face-to-face` as `RouteGroup` for GoRouter.
- **Works:** Registered in `glasses_app` and `pkg_showcase`.

---

### l10n

#### `assets/l10n/app_zh.arb` + `app_en.arb` (21 keys each)
- **Complete parity:** zh and en have identical key sets.
- **Used in UI (~12 keys):** `entryTitle`, `entryDescription`, `oneKeyTitle`, `faceToFaceTitle`, `holdToRecordHint`, `recordingStatus`, `translatingStatus`, `speakerALabel`, `speakerBLabel`, `audioOutputAction`, `clearHistoryAction`, `historyEmptyHint`, `networkError` (one-key only).
- **Unused (~9 keys):** `recognizingStatus`, `ttsPlayingStatus`, `tapForSpeakerA`, `audioOutputTipTitle`, `audioOutputTipMessage`, `deviceNotConnectedError`, `microphoneFailedError`, `unknownError`, `retryButton`, `cancelAction`, `confirmAction`.

---

### Tests

#### `test/translate_sse_response_test.dart`
- **Covers:** SSE parsing (partial/final ASR, translation, TTS bytes/base64, snake_case, edge cases) + `resolveTranslateDirection` (3 cases).
- **Missing:** Controller lifecycle, upload service, UI/widget tests, BLE push behavior, permission flows, error state transitions, one-key vs face-to-face entry commit logic.

---

## Deep Dive: Face-to-Face Mode

### How it works
1. User selects language pair in bar (e.g. 中文 → 英语).
2. **甲方 (speaker 0)** long-presses left mic → `startRecording(speaker: 0)` → API called with `fromId=175, toId=83`.
3. **乙方 (speaker 1)** long-presses right mic → `startRecording(speaker: 1)` → direction **reversed** via `resolveTranslateDirection`: `fromId=83, toId=175`.
4. While live, only the active speaker’s mic works; the other’s `onRecordStart` is no-op.
5. Release → `stopRecording()` → status `processing` → SSE completes → entry committed to list → idle.
6. Bubbles: speaker 0 right-aligned (accent), speaker 1 left-aligned (neutral).

### Language direction flip
**Not** triggered by the swap button during a session — swap only affects the configured pair for speaker 0. Flip happens **per recording** based on which mic was pressed:

```306:317:packages/feature/ai/feature_translate/lib/src/controller/translate_controller.dart
({int fromId, int toId}) resolveTranslateDirection({
  required bool isFtf,
  required int speaker,
  required ({int fromId, int toId}) selected,
}) {
  if (isFtf && speaker == 1) {
    return (fromId: selected.toId, toId: selected.fromId);
  }
  return (fromId: selected.fromId, toId: selected.toId);
}
```

### UI flow
Entry tile/sheet → `FaceToFaceTranslatePage` → language bar → conversation list (empty hint / bubbles / in-progress bubble) → dual mic bar at bottom.

---

## Deep Dive: One-Key Mode

- Single mic, always `speaker: 0`, direction = configured pair (no flip).
- Result area shows streaming ASR + translation while live; after completion keeps **only the latest** entry (replaces history).
- Hold-to-record hint in status label when idle.
- Only mode with visible error text.

---

## Audio Recording Lifecycle

| Phase | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| Start | Guard `isLive`; clear error; request `AppPermission.microphone`; create `InterpretationAudioEngine` with `simultaneousInterpretation` purpose |
| Recording | PCM → 1280-byte chunks → `_audioBridge` stream → upload POST body |
| Stop | Cancel audio sub; flush buffer; close bridge (signals server end-of-audio); status → `processing`; engine kept for TTS |
| Complete | Commit entry; `awaitTtsDrained()` if TTS on; status → `idle`; cleanup engine |
| Permission denied | status → `error`, raw message (not l10n) |
| Mic start fail | status → `error`, `e.toString()` |
| Mic stream error | Logged + bridge error; no dedicated UI path |
| Dispose | Full cleanup on provider dispose |

**Missing vs interpretation:** No BLE-gated recording, no auto-stop on disconnect, no `setRecording` BLE command to glasses, no communication AEC route setup.

---

## SSE Response Parsing & Display

| Event | Handler | UI |
|-------|---------|-----|
| ASR partial | Updates `currentAsrText` | Live bubble / one-key result |
| ASR final | Sets `_finalAsrText` | Used on commit |
| Translation | Updates `currentTransText` + BLE push | Live + committed |
| TTS | `pushTtsPcm` if enabled | Audible only; no `ttsPlayingStatus` in UI |
| SSE error | Commit partial entry, status `error`, cleanup | **One-key only** |
| SSE done | Commit entry, drain TTS, idle | Both modes |

**Gaps:** No visual distinction between partial and final translation; translation `isFinal` parsed but ignored for BLE; no handling for server-side error events in SSE payload.

---

## Error States Shown to User

| Error source | One-key | Face-to-face |
|--------------|---------|--------------|
| Mic permission | `error` status, shown as `networkError(raw)` | `error` status, **nothing shown** |
| Mic start failure | Same | Same |
| SSE/network failure | Same | Same |
| BLE push failure | Silent log | Silent log |
| Language list failure | Silent fallback to 2 langs | Same |

No retry button, no snackbar/toast, no typed error messages (`deviceNotConnectedError`, `microphoneFailedError` exist in l10n but unused).

---

## Glasses (BLE) Integration

```278:290:packages/feature/ai/feature_translate/lib/src/controller/translate_controller.dart
void _pushTranslationToGlasses(String text) {
  if (text.isEmpty || !_bleConnected) return;
  try {
    ref.read(glassesCommandSenderProvider).send(
      GlassesOrder.sendSimInterText(
        content: text,
        isStream: false,
        isAsr: false,
      ),
    );
  } catch (e) {
    _log('BLE push failed (non-fatal): $e');
  }
}
```

| Aspect | Current | Interpretation reference |
|--------|---------|--------------------------|
| Translation push | `0x46/0x03`, `isStream=false`, `isAsr=false` | Same for finals |
| ASR push to glasses | **No** | Yes (streaming + final) |
| Status frames | **No** (`sendSimInterStatus`) | Yes (busy/error/timeout) |
| Device recording sync | **No** | `setRecording(enabled:)` |
| Disconnect handling | **No** | Auto-stop + dialog |
| MTU fragmentation | Not handled (ponytail on `GlassesOrder`) | Same ponytail |
| App entry BLE gate | One-key tile requires BLE; face-to-face sheet does not | — |

Phone works fully without glasses (display-only fallback) — by design per controller comment.

---

## Prioritized Gap List for Planning

### P0 — User-visible correctness
1. **Face-to-face error UI** — mirror one-key error banner or shared error widget
2. **Typed error messages** — map permission/mic/network/BLE to l10n (`microphoneFailedError`, `networkError`, `deviceNotConnectedError`)
3. **TTS toggle headphone warning** — copy interpretation’s `showDialog` before enabling TTS
4. **Mute TTS cleanup** — call `resetTtsOutput()` when disabling TTS mid-session

### P1 — Glasses parity
5. BLE disconnect auto-stop during live session
6. Push translation only on `isFinal` (or explicit streaming with `isStream: true`)
7. Optional: `sendSimInterStatus` on SSE errors
8. Consider ASR streaming to glasses for face-to-face

### P2 — UX polish
9. Use `recognizingStatus` / `ttsPlayingStatus` in mic labels or result area
10. Face-to-face-specific empty hint
11. Language picker loading state + sheet title l10n
12. Retry action on error state
13. Localize recording dot in `TranslateMicButton`
14. Wire or remove dead `TranslateConfig` fields (`authorization`, `apiKey`, `enableTts`)

### P3 — Robustness
15. Bounded audio buffer (ponytail upgrade)
16. Processing timeout if SSE never completes
17. `mutualTranslationFlag` evaluation for simpler server contract
18. History persistence (none today; interpretation has local history)

### P4 — Test coverage
19. Controller tests (mock upload/audio/BLE)
20. `resolveTranslateDirection` already covered; add entry-commit and error-path tests
21. Widget smoke tests for error display and dual-mic gating

---

## Comparison Snapshot: vs `feature_interpretation`

| Capability | Translate | Interpretation |
|------------|-----------|----------------|
| Transport | HTTP POST + SSE | WebSocket |
| History | In-memory only | Persisted |
| Error model | Raw string | Typed `InterpretationErrorKind` |
| TTS safety dialog | Missing | Present |
| BLE lifecycle | Push text only | Full status + recording sync |
| Disconnect handling | None | Auto-stop + dialog |
| Test depth | 1 file, ~15 cases | Multiple test files |

---

## Bottom Line

The **core translation pipeline is implemented and wired** into `glasses_app` with routes, config injection, and l10n delegates. Face-to-face’s **speaker-based direction flip and chat UI work as designed**. The biggest improvement opportunities are **error UX (especially face-to-face)**, **TTS/BLE parity with interpretation**, and **closing the gap between defined l10n strings and actual UI usage**. Test coverage is intentionally minimal (ponytail comment) and would need expansion before treating this as production-hardened.
